div.head: EGu 6
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwá teoðunge forheolde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum.
Gif hwa teoþunge forhealde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Et si quis decimam contrateneat, reddat lahslit cum Dacis, witam cum Anglis.
Gif hwa teoþunge forhealde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
If anyone withholds tithe, he shall pay lahslit in a Danish district, and a fine in an English district.
Wenn jemand den Zehnten vorenthält, zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse bei den Dänen, Strafgeld bei den Engländern.
If anyone withholds tithe, let him pay the penalty for breach of law among the Danes, a fine among the English.
